question: What did dock workers at Chittagong refuse to unload in March 1971, in an early act of organized civilian resistance?

options.text: Military cargo, including arms, from the ship MV Swat
Textile exports bound for West Pakistan

explanation: Port workers refused to unload arms from the MV Swat at Chittagong in March 1971, an early act of organized civilian resistance. Sources differ on the exact day.
